transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I’m here because… things at the warehouse don’t feel right. The routing system, the scanners—it's not just computers messing up. It feels like they’re tracking my moves, sending messages, trying to push me out because I’ve been there a long time.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or irritable lately?
No… I don’t think so. Not high or energized. Irritable maybe sometimes, but… I wouldn’t call it unusual.
Do you hear voices when no one else is around?
Yeah… sometimes. Like when I’m in my garage, everything’s off, nobody’s there, and I still hear dispatch voices. They call my operator number… say I’m dangerous, or that security’s coming for me.
Have you used any drugs or substances recently that could affect your mind, like meth, cocaine, cannabis, or hallucinogens?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been taking anything like that.
During this time, have you felt like you have special powers or an unusually important mission?

Not special powers, no… not like that. But I do feel like the routing system at the warehouse is… watching where I go. Like it’s marking my moves through the scanners, sending messages to push me out because I’m one of the old hands there.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do things you used to normally do?

Yeah… I guess so. Fishing, choir practice, working with wood out in the garage… those used to calm me down. Now I can be looking right at the rods or the tools and just… feel nothing pulling me to do it.
How long have these voices and the feeling that the warehouse is tracking you been going on?
It’s been… a while. Maybe about a year and eight months now, with the voices and the scanner thing.
Before these problems started, did you have any major medical illness or head injury?
Not that I can think of. I mean… I’ve had the usual aches and things, but no big illness or head injury before all this.
During the time these voices and tracking concerns have been happening, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. When I was at my lowest, I wasn’t eating much, stopped going to choir… felt like I’d let everybody down. And the scanner messages and dispatch voices were still happening right along with it.
Have there been times when the voices or the feeling that the warehouse was tracking you were happening even though you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah… there were times. My mood had let up some, I guess. I was eating a bit more, talking some. But the voices were still there for weeks… dispatch calling my number, and I still thought the routing system was tracking me.
Have the voices or the feeling that the warehouse was tracking you ever lasted for at least two weeks when you were not depressed at all?

Yeah… I think so. There was a time when I wasn’t really feeling depressed like before — I was eating some, talking a little more — but the dispatch voice was still calling my number, and I still felt like the routing system was tracking me. That went on for several weeks.
Do people ever tell you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts jump around?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. People don’t usually say it straight to me. I try to keep it short so it doesn’t get like that.
Have people told you that your face seems less expressive or that your voice sounds flat?
Yeah… my wife says that. Says my face doesn’t show much anymore, and I don’t really answer her. Most days I just sit at the kitchen table, looking at my coffee… don’t get started on much.
Have you ever felt that someone could put thoughts into your mind or take thoughts out of it?

Not really like… thoughts put in my head. It’s more that the routing system at the warehouse knows where I am, marks my moves. The scanners send messages, kind of pushing me out… because I’ve been there a long time. One of the old hands.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt full of energy?
No… I don’t think so. I’ve had trouble sleeping, but not where I’m full of energy for a week or anything like that.
Have there been times when your behavior got so disorganized that other people said you were acting very oddly or couldn't manage basic daily tasks?

Yeah… I guess so. At work, sometimes at home too, I get… mixed up. I’ll just stand there like my hands are still on the forklift controls, and I keep saying the same safety phrase. People try to talk to me, but I don’t really… switch out of it.
Have you ever had a time when you felt unusually high or full of energy for several days in a row?
No… not high like that. I get worn out more than anything. I don’t think I’ve had several days where I was full of energy.
Altogether since these problems began, have you been depressed for most of that time?

Yeah… I’d say most of the time. Even when the warehouse stuff wasn’t as loud, I still felt pretty down. Empty, I guess. I couldn’t really get back into fishing or woodworking… even sitting down for family meals felt like too much.
